name: Republic of the Congo
description: The Republic of the Congo from the kingdoms of Loango and Teke to French Congo, independence in 1960, Marxism, civil war and oil.

checkpoints.name: Kingdoms of the coast
checkpoints.note: Loango on the coast and the Teke on the plateaus traded ivory and slaves with Europeans.

checkpoints.name: French Congo
checkpoints.note: Brazza claimed the land for France in 1880. Brazzaville became the capital of French Equatorial Africa.

checkpoints.name: Independent Congo
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960, then a Marxist state, civil war in the late 1990s and the long rule of Sassou Nguesso.
